voiceover:
[conversational] ChatGPT might remember more about you than your own family does.

Most people have never looked at what's actually stored. [serious] Let's fix that.

Open Settings, then Personalization, then Memory, then Manage. You can review every memory and delete the ones you don't want. You can also turn memory off completely, or use Temporary Chat for anything private.

[playful] Now the fun part. If memory's on, ask it these 3 things.

First: "What skill or talent am I ignoring that could change my life if I worked on it?"

Second: "If you were me, with my strengths and weaknesses, what decisions would you make next?"

Third: "Based on all our chats, how different is what I say from what I do? Be blunt."

[whispers] The catch? It only knows what you've told it. So treat the answers as a mirror, not a verdict.

Which answer hurt the most? Tell me in the comments.

Send this to the friend who tells ChatGPT everything.
